public_rationale: The cryptocurrency revenue description holds. The exclusive-buildout assertion does not: another development partnership had already announced facilities for CoreWeave. Core Scientific also publicly described a commissioned AI-ready facility in 2019. That establishes prior experience, though not necessarily ground-up construction at the scale contemplated in 2025. The gigawatt figure is not independently resolved here.
limitations: Developer announcements establish arrangements and reported facility history, not independent construction audits.
The finding does not imply that Core Scientific was a minor supplier or that its newer projects posed little execution risk.
Gross power and critical IT load cannot be compared directly.

statement.document_title: The Phony Comforts of AI Optimism

from_speaker: in the hands of Core Scientific
doesn't appear to have built an AI data center before
majority of its money from mining and selling crypto
our_interpretation: Entire means all of CoreWeave's planned buildout, not merely an important supplier relationship.
Read money as revenue in the company financial disclosures discussed in the post, not net profit or financing proceeds.
Use fiscal 2024 for the revenue clause, the latest disclosed annual period before publication.
Assess contracted buildout as it stood at publication. The prior-construction clause covers history before publication, so the combined target interval has no lower bound.
The phrase doesn't appear qualifies the speaker's confidence. Assess whether public evidence of a prior AI facility existed, without claiming to know what he personally saw.
The financial metric scope applies to the revenue clause; construction history and developer relationships are nonmonetary subclaims.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records place all relevant CoreWeave expansion exceeding one gigawatt with Core Scientific, show no documented prior AI facility, and establish that cryptocurrency mining supplies most Core Scientific revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented buildout with another developer defeats the exclusive-dependence clause; a documented prior AI facility defeats the apparent lack of experience; cryptocurrency revenue of half or less defeats the majority clause.
